description: We are a group of students from New Jersey that aspires to create a meaningful project and learn through this experience.
summary: We created a health monitoring system for astronauts that walks them through each step of their healthcare. We added input boxes for each of the manual values(e.g. blood saturation). It is 100% offline and local, with no reliance on the cloud.
details: AstroTwin is 100% offline. It tracks 16 physiological, behavioral, and environmental metrics, combining sensors and onboard logs. It also calculates each astronaut's personal 7-day baseline rather than relying solely on static Earth cutoffs. An anatomical SVG silhouette color-codes four key spaceflight systems (Cardiovascular, Immune & Hematologic, Neurobehavioral & Ocular/SANS, and Musculoskeletal) as Green, Amber, or Red. Clicking these provides steps and clear explanations. Astrotwin provides immediate guidance for Astronauts to manage their health in case of communication delays and mishaps. By running entirely locally on spacecraft hardware with zero external API or internet dependencies, the system remains immune to deep-space network blackouts. The following was used: Python 3, NiceGUI, Plotly, SQLite, Pandas, NumPy. We considered that everything was stored locally so it could run all the time. Deep space exposes humans simultaneously to microgravity, cosmic radiation, elevated cabin, and confinement. Our risk engine accounts for how these factors compound.
